stem: In the same plane, lines $\ell$ and $m$ are each perpendicular to line $n$.

options.text: Only the shared reference line $n$ can be called parallel.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice that uses the shared perpendicular.

part_answers.answer: Two lines perpendicular to the same line are parallel.

teacher.key_rationale: Lines perpendicular to the same line in a plane are parallel, so ℓ ∥ m. They need not meet. Parallelism is about ℓ and m, not only naming n.
